provenance.basis: local owned live Chromium fixture on Hyprland 0.56.2; source-tree runs, reviewed measurements, not a third-party independence claim
provenance.design: 24 blocks across 6 delay/control workloads and 2 task routes, 60 samples per variant per cell; blocks ran B,A,A,B; repeats, not 1440 distinct scenarios
provenance.raw_source: 24 private run files MUSE2-logs/controls{0,1000}-delay{0,50,250}-{A1,A2,B1,B2}.json (private; hashes below identify them, files not published)
provenance.candidate_change: CDP assertion poll interval 50 ms -> 10 ms only
provenance.timing_scope: fresh observe + act + independent fixture verification; session startup, discovery and model inference excluded
provenance.sanitized_fields_removed: none present in raw samples; kept fields are file/sha/controls/delay/variant/runtimeSHA/mode/index/ok/timing/result_bytes

method.median: statistics.median over pooled per-cell samples (B1+B2 or A1+A2)
